notes: CAMPUS: taught at EETAC in CASTELLDEFELS, ~20 km from Barcelona — do not record as Barcelona. LEGAL POINT: a Spanish long-stay study authorisation does not confer resident status (Catalonia Decret 96/2026 art. 1.5), so a Tunisian student pays the 45.00 rate and cannot escape it by living in Catalonia. Complementos formativos: 0 per RUCT (title-level); applicant-level complementos are decided at admission and were not published. 60 ECTS.

programme_name: Máster Universitario en Ciencia de Datos (Data Science)
autonomous_community: Catalunya (awarding university's seat: Barcelona — UOC, Av. Tibidabo 39-43 / Rambla del Poblenou 156)
campus: 100% online, no physical campus attendance; UOC seat Barcelona
institution_type: public university that charges private-style fees — RECORD BOTH: UOC is a public-law/public-initiative university created by the Generalitat de Catalunya, its title is verified by the Consejo de Universidades and authorised by the Generalitat, and its own page says prices are 'regulados por la Generalitat'; BUT the tariff it charges is private-style, ~25.82 EUR/cr teaching + 18.30 EUR/cr learning-resources = ~44.12 EUR/cr, far above the 19.37 EUR/cr a Catalan public campus university (e.g. UPC) charges for the same official master.
official_status: máster universitario (OFFICIAL) — page: 'Titulación oficial'; 'titulación que ha sido verificada por el Consejo de Universidades, y su implantación ha sido autorizada por la Generalitat de Cataluña'; quality endorsed by AQU Catalunya
boe_order: RUCT estado 'Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA POR ACREDITACIÓN INSTITUCIONAL)'; verificación 23/06/2017; BOE 07/09/2018 and 13/02/2025; Resolución Favorable Renov. Acreditación 28/09/2021
europe_recognition: EHEA level 7 (Bologna) — academic recognition across the EHEA. Evidence: RUCT 4316294, MECES nivel 3 (= EQF/EHEA 7), Máster Universitario. UOC states the degree serves 'la movilidad de estudiantes y titulados dentro del espacio europeo de educación superior (EEES)' but ALSO warns, correctly, 'La validez en otros países de los títulos universitarios oficiales expedidos por la UOC vendrá determinada en cada caso por las leyes de educación de cada país' — i.e. recognition abroad still runs through the receiving country's own procedure; the EHEA makes it routine, not automatic. Academic recognition is not professional recognition for a regulated profession (Directive 2005/36/EC, separate national process).
tuition_eu_eur: EUR 2,900 for the 60-ECTS master (UOC 'Precios para estudiantes de la Unión Europea': 'Precio orientativo a tiempo completo (1 año)**: 2.900,00 €'; per-credit 25,82 €/cr teaching + 18,30 €/cr 'herramientas y recursos para el aprendizaje' + 5,16 €/cr for convalidated subjects). Prices stated as 'vigentes en el momento de formalizar la matrícula. Sujetos a revisión anual' — page live 2026-08-29, next inscripción October 2026 for the 17 Feb 2027 start.
tuition_non_eu_eur: EUR 4,330 full-time (1 year) / EUR 4,840 part-time (2 years) — UOC's own table headed 'Precios para estudiantes de fuera de la Unión Europea'. Mechanism stated verbatim: 'El estudiantado de nacionalidad de fuera de la Unión Europea, países con régimen comunitario o fuera de Andorra, que no tenga concedida la residencia en el Estado español tendrá un incremento del 45% en el precio final de la matrícula.' This candidate (Tunisian, no Spanish residency) pays the non-EU figure.
tuition_year_of_rates: Rates as published on the live page 2026-08-29, applying to the matrícula opening October 2026 for the February 2027 start; UOC labels them 'vigentes en el momento de formalizar la matrícula, sujetos a revisión anual' rather than tagging an academic year.
fees_extra_eur: NOT FOUND as a separate figure — UOC folds 'tasa de gestión del expediente y la matrícula' into the orientative total; the page does not print its amount. Both orientative totals are explicitly computed on 60 ECTS only and exclude the 12 ECTS of complementos (see notes).
modality: 100% online, no fixed timetable ('Online y sin horarios')
language_of_instruction: Español OR Catalán — 'Idiomas: Español, Catalán'; 'El mismo programa se ofrece en las dos lenguas en aulas diferentes'. NOT available in English. This is a hard filter for a Spanish-A1 candidate.
start_month: February — 'Inicio 17 feb 2027'; 'Próxima inscripción: octubre 2026'. UOC runs two matriculation moments a year (matriculación a partir de abril for Sept/Oct starts; the other for February starts).
notes: THE COST TRAP — REAL LOAD IS 72 ECTS, NOT 60. UOC imposes 12 ECTS of complementos de formación on EVERY student with NO exemption, verbatim: 'se requerirá a TODOS los estudiantes la superación obligatoria de los siguientes créditos de formación compensatoria: Programación para la ciencia de datos (6 ECTS), Bases de datos analíticas (6 ECTS)'; 'tiene la restricción de matricular obligatoriamente las dos asignaturas de complementos de formación durante el primer curso académico'; 'No se podrá continuar los estudios hasta que no se superen los complementos.' The plan de estudios footnote confirms: '* En esta planificación no se incluyen los 12 ECTS de complementos de formación, adicionales y obligatorios para titularse.' CONSEQUENCE: the 2,900 / 4,330 headline prices are calculated on 60 ECTS and therefore UNDERSTATE the real cost. DERIVED (my arithmetic, not published by UOC): 12 extra ECTS at 25,82+18,30 = 44,12 EUR/cr = +529.44 EUR for an EU student, and with the stated 45% non-EU increment 44,12 x 1.45 x 12 = +767.69 EUR, i.e. a realistic non-EU total nearer 5,100 EUR than 4,330 EUR. Treat that derived total as an estimate; UOC publishes no 72-ECTS price. NOTE ALSO: 2,900 x 1.45 = 4,205, which does not reproduce the published 4,330 — the 45% is applied to the 'precio final de la matrícula' including fixed fees, so the published 4,330 is the figure to rely on, not the multiplication. 300-ECTS QUESTION: the candidate's 300-ECTS Software Engineering degree does NOT buy exemption from the 12 complementos — they are unconditional. It does satisfy access: the required knowledge field 'Ingeniería informática y de sistemas' is one of the six RD 822/2021 anexo I fields UOC lists. UOC does run 'reconocimiento de créditos' for prior study and professional experience, applied case by case — not quantified on the page. RUCT hint check: input hint 4316294 CONFIRMED against RUCT detail (title and university match exactly, Universitat Oberta de Catalunya, Ciencia de Datos). RUCT publishes ects_complementos_formativos as null for this title = NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT, which is not the same as 0 — and the programme page shows the real answer is 12.

programme_name: Màster Universitari en Enginyeria de Telecomunicació / Máster Universitario en Ingeniería de Telecomunicación
campus: 100% online ('Online i sense horari'), no physical campus attendance; UOC seat Barcelona
university_awarding: Universitat Oberta de Catalunya (UOC) — SOLE awarder. CORRECTION TO INPUT: the input said 'joint with Universitat Ramon Llull (La Salle)'. NOT SUPPORTED. The RUCT title is 'Máster Universitario en Ingeniería de Telecomunicación POR LA UNIVERSITAT OBERTA DE CATALUNYA' with no second university, and the UOC programme page names no partner institution. The only 'Universitat Ramon Llull' string on the page is the doctoral alma mater of the programme director Carlos Monzo Sánchez. 'La Salle' does not appear on the page at all.
institution_type: public university that charges private-style fees — RECORD BOTH: UOC is a public-law/public-initiative university (title verified by the Consell d'Universitats, implantation authorised by the Generalitat de Catalunya, quality accredited by AQU); but it charges 20,42 EUR/cr teaching + 18,30 EUR/cr learning resources = 38,72 EUR/cr, roughly double UPC's 19,37 EUR/cr public rate for the same official master.
official_status: máster universitario (OFFICIAL) — verbatim: 'Aquesta titulació ha estat verificada pel Consell d'Universitats, i la Generalitat de Catalunya n'ha autoritzat la implantació'; 'Els títols universitaris oficials de la UOC tenen validesa en tot el territori espanyol, tenen efectes acadèmics plens'
ruct_code: 3500090 — CORRECTED. The input hint was 4316386, which RUCT shows as 'Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN A EXTINGUIR)', i.e. being wound down and NOT the title open to a 2027 intake. The live title is RUCT 3500090, 'Máster Universitario en Ingeniería de Telecomunicación por la Universitat Oberta de Catalunya', estado 'Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA POR ACREDITACIÓN INSTITUCIONAL)'. Confirmed by matching the page's 90 ECTS structure (72 obligatòria + 18 treball final) to RUCT 3500090's 72 obligatorios + 18 TFM = 90; the extinguishing 4316386 does not match.
boe_order: RUCT 3500090: nivel académico 'Máster - RD 822/2021 (3)'; verificación 24/11/2023; BOE 27/09/2024 and 04/06/2026; Resolución Favorable Acreditación Institucional 01/03/2022
europe_recognition: EHEA level 7 (Bologna) — academic recognition across the EHEA. Evidence: RUCT 3500090, MECES nivel 3 (= EQF/EHEA 7), Máster Universitario RD 822/2021. UOC states verbatim that the title is issued 'juntament amb el suplement europeu al títol (SET)' whose purpose is 'facilitar-ne el reconeixement i promoure la mobilitat d'estudiants i titulats dins de l'espai europeu d'educació superior (EEES)'. UOC ALSO states, correctly, 'La validesa en altres països dels títols universitaris oficials expedits per la UOC vindrà determinada en cada cas per les lleis d'educació de cada país' — recognition abroad still runs through the receiving country's procedure. SEPARATE POINT ON PROFESSIONAL RECOGNITION: this is a Spanish 'máster habilitante' for the regulated profession of Ingeniero de Telecomunicación; UOC's wording is 'habiliten, si escau, per a la realització d'activitats professionals regulades, d'acord amb la normativa que en cada cas resulti aplicable' — that professional habilitation is Spanish and does NOT transfer automatically to another EU state, which runs its own Directive 2005/36/EC process.
diploma_supplement: YES — explicitly: 'Aquests títols s'expedeixen juntament amb el suplement europeu al títol (SET)'
tuition_eu_eur: NO PROGRAMME TOTAL PUBLISHED for EU students — UOC's EU table gives per-credit only: 'Preu per crèdit 20,42 €/cr', 'Preu per crèdit eines i recursos per a l'aprenentatge 18,30 €/cr', 'Preu per crèdit d'assignatures convalidades 4,08 €/cr'. DERIVED (my arithmetic, not published by UOC): (20,42 + 18,30) x 90 ECTS = 38,72 x 90 = EUR 3,484.80, excluding fixed matriculation/expediente fees and excluding any complementos de formación.
tuition_non_eu_eur: EUR 5,790 full-time (1.5 years) / EUR 6,580 part-time (3 years) — UOC's own table headed 'Preus per a estudiants de fora de la Unió Europea', calculated on 90 credits. Mechanism verbatim: 'L'estudiantat de nacionalitat de fora de la Unió Europea, països amb règim comunitari o fora d'Andorra, que no tingui concedida la residència a l'Estat espanyol tindrà un increment del 45% al preu final de la matrícula.' This candidate (Tunisian, no Spanish residency) pays this.
tuition_year_of_rates: Rates as published on the live page 2026-08-29; UOC labels them 'Preus vigents en el moment de formalitzar la matrícula. Subjectes a revisió anual' rather than tagging an academic year.
fees_extra_eur: NOT FOUND as a separate figure — the fixed 'tasa de gestió de l'expedient i la matrícula' amount is not printed on the programme page. Note 3,484.80 (derived EU) x 1.45 = 5,053, which does NOT reproduce the published non-EU 5,790; the ~737 EUR gap is the fixed fees the 45% is also applied to, so rely on UOC's published 5,790, not on the multiplication.
language_of_instruction: Català AND Castellà — 'Idiomes: Català, Castellà'; verbatim: 'Estudiants d'aquestes dues llengües comparteixen aula, i la docència es fa tant en català com en castellà.' Students share ONE classroom taught in both languages (unlike the Data Science master, which splits them into separate aules). NOT available in English. A hard filter for a Spanish-A1 candidate, and harder than the Data Science master because Catalan cannot be avoided.
start_month: CONFLICT — the programme page states only 'Inici 23 set. 2026' (a SEPTEMBER start), with 'Inscripció oberta: últims dies'. The February/March option comes from UOC's university-wide boilerplate, verbatim: 'Matriculació a partir de l'abril per començar el curs al setembre o octubre / Matriculació a partir de l'octubre per començar el curs al febrer o març', which itself instructs 'Consulta el termini de matriculació i l'inici de curs a la pàgina dels estudis que t'interessin cursar' — and that page shows September only. So the input's 'February (or March) second-semester entry' is NOT confirmed for this specific title; a February cohort must be checked with UOC admissions before relying on it. Recorded as CONFLICT, not resolved.
notes: THREE THINGS THE INPUT GOT WRONG OR UNDERSTATED, all corrected above: (1) RUCT hint 4316386 is a TITULACIÓN A EXTINGUIR — real code 3500090; (2) no Universitat Ramon Llull / La Salle co-award exists; (3) the February start is not stated on the programme page. FOURTH: this is a 90-ECTS master, not 60 — 1.5 years full time, and the fee scales accordingly. COMPLEMENTOS / 300-ECTS QUESTION: verbatim 'En funció de la via d'accés, cal cursar fins a un màxim de 18 crèdits ECTS com a complements de formació. Si s'han de cursar més de 18 crèdits de complements de formació, no es pot accedir al màster.' So complementos here are 0-18 ECTS depending on the applicant's degree and are an ACCESS GATE, not just a cost: a Software Engineering (not Telecommunications) background is exactly the profile at risk of exceeding 18 and being refused. RUCT publishes ects_complementos_formativos = 0 for the TITLE, which as the brief warns is not the applicant-level answer — the applicant-level answer is the 0-18 rule above. Complementos must be taken in the first academic year, in parallel with master subjects. CREDIT RECOGNITION: UOC runs 'reconeixement acadèmic de l'experiència professional (RAEP)' — 'es poden convalidar fins al 15% dels crèdits de la titulació' (= up to 13.5 of 90 ECTS), at 4,08 EUR/cr for convalidated subjects.
